summary: Eldorado Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing first copper concentrate production at its 100%-owned McIlvenna Bay project in Saskatchewan, Canada. No transaction, stakeholder activity, or structural change is involved. This is a routine operational milestone update regarding wet and hot commissioning, ramp-up to 4,900 tonnes per day, and expected commercial production in Q3 2026, with $17 million of additional exploration spending committed. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or risk-arb angles. The filing is an ordinary operational report and does not constitute a special situation.
